description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Polymarket odds for an event: up to 10 markets matching a keyword with YES probability, 1h/24h/7d odds change, volume and liquidity. Examples: q=bitcoin, q=election. Refreshed about every 30 min. Returns JSON for up to 10 matching markets: YES probability, 1h, 24h, and 7d odds change, volume, and liquidity.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

q.description: Keyword in the market question. Format: plain words. Example: bitcoin. The tool text also uses election. Required.

name: lookup_polymarket
title: Polymarket odds search ($0.005)
